list.empty: Add customized reports to get a detailed overview of your studio.

descriptions.dayBookings: Analyze trends and participation rates by tracking group activity bookings for each day.
descriptions.privateService: Analyze appointments’ performance with the number of bookings and cancellations.
descriptions.activityByCoach: Track the performance of activities and workshops by teacher. Improve teacher assignments and program success.
descriptions.activityByEst: Track the performance of activities and workshops by establishment. Improve resource allocation for each establishment.
descriptions.workshop: Evaluate workshop performance. Analyze data to improve offerings and increase participation.
descriptions.activities: Access details of each activity. Track attendance and performance to improve program offerings.
descriptions.first_privatebooking: Track first visitors and best-performing appointments with a detailed list of the first booking for each member.
descriptions.first_attendance: Monitor initial attendance for group activities. Track engagement and optimize onboarding strategies to improve member retention.
descriptions.first_booking: Track first visitors and best performing classes with a detailed list of the first group activity booking for each member.
descriptions.subscription: Track subscription billing details to ensure accurate and timely payments.
descriptions.discount: Optimize marketing strategies and increase sales by analyzing the impact of promotions.
descriptions.private_bookings: Access detailed booking information for appointments and improve scheduling efficiency.
descriptions.shop: Optimize inventory and sales strategies by monitoring sales, generated income and stock levels.
descriptions.private_cpasses: See active appointment passes and their usage. Track bookings and remaining credits to manage appointment passes efficiently.
descriptions.payment_sumup: Monitor all payment details and methods, both online and offline.
descriptions.credit: View members’ account balances quickly. Communicate effectively with members about their dues and credits.
descriptions.basket: See a list of pending basket items, providing insight into what members are considering purchasing.
descriptions.memberships: See active passes and their usage. Track bookings and remaining credits to manage passes efficiently.
descriptions.invoices: Track transaction history and analyze billing details.
descriptions.payments: Access detailed information of each transaction with status and products sold.
descriptions.bookings: Optimize scheduling by analyzing booking status, attendance, and membership usage.
descriptions.offers: Optimize scheduling and resource use by understanding sessions’ bookings dynamics.
descriptions.members: Access details of new members to understand their preferences to improve member experience and loyalty.
descriptions.cashbook: Monitor daily balances for accurate financial management.
descriptions.on_spot_payments: Track in-studio payments with transactions’ details and monitor sales to improve product offering.
descriptions.video: Analyze VOD performance like views, price, and rental status to inform your content strategy.
descriptions.unpaid_invoices: Track unpaid invoices to improve payment collection.
descriptions.video_purchase: Monitor sales by tracking all purchased videos and their details and optimize video offerings.
descriptions.giftcard: Monitor sales and redemptions to improve gift card offerings and maximize revenue.
descriptions.consumer_giftcard: Manage and track gift card purchases, including details of purchasers and recipients.
descriptions.payment_installments: Track instalment payments’ statuses and view details including due dates, prices, and products.
descriptions.unpaid_private_bookings: Track unpaid appointments to improve payment collection and follow-up with members.
descriptions.expense: Track expenses from the webshop and suppliers. Gain insights into spending patterns to improve cost efficiency.
descriptions.expired_pass: Identify expired passes with unused credits.
descriptions.private_cpasses_expired: Identify expired appointment passes with unused credits.
descriptions.universal_passes: See active universal passes and their usage. Track bookings and remaining credits to manage universal passes efficiently.
descriptions.franchise_shared_pass: View and compare in which of your studios shared passes were purchased and then used.
descriptions.billing_plan: Monitor subscription statuses, renewal dates and recurring revenue.
descriptions.members_purchase: Track all purchases and details of items purchased by members. Gain insights to optimize product offerings.
descriptions.referral_grant: Boost member engagement by tracking referred and referring members, including dates of use and products purchased.
descriptions.access_monitoring: Track member access to your facility with entry logs and status alerts.
